bullets.text: EU Charger Confusion Clarified - **Apple**'s M5 MacBook Pro lacks a charger, but it's not due to EU law.
M5 MacBook Pro Power Adapter Update - The latest **Apple** model sold in the UK and EU excludes a power adapter.
New Studio Display Features Rumored - **Apple** hints at a 120Hz refresh rate for the upcoming Studio Display.
AT&T Internet Price Hike - **AT&T** raises home internet prices by $5/month for the second consecutive year.
Reddit Expands AI Search - **Reddit** introduces AI-powered search in five new languages, enhancing user experience.
OpenAI Pauses Controversial Video Feature - **OpenAI** halts Sora video generations of Martin Luther King Jr. after backlash.
Waymo Partners with DoorDash - **Waymo** resumes delivery services through a new partnership with **DoorDash** in Phoenix.
Pinterest Limits AI Content - **Pinterest** adds controls to reduce AI-generated content in user feeds amid backlash.
Meta Shuts Down Messenger Apps - **Meta** will discontinue Messenger desktop apps for Mac and Windows by December 15.
Deel Achieves $17.3B Valuation - **Deel** raises $300M, reaching a valuation of $17.3 billion amid corporate rivalry.
